resources.string: Update your AniList progress as you finish anime episodes.
Finishing an anime episode moves its AniList entry forward. To bring your AniList history into Fetch, use Import from another source.
Sign in from your phone: Settings → Configure from phone, scan the code, then open Accounts → AniList.
Sign in to AniList and approve Fetch. AniList then shows a long token: copy it, come back here and paste it below.
AniList didn’t accept that token. Sign in again and copy the whole token.
Update your MyAnimeList progress as you finish anime episodes.
Finishing an anime episode moves its MyAnimeList entry forward. To bring your MyAnimeList history into Fetch, use Import from another source.
Sign in from your phone: Settings → Configure from phone, scan the code, then open Accounts → MyAnimeList.
Sign in to MyAnimeList and allow Fetch. You land on a Fetch page showing a sign-in code: copy it, come back here and paste it below within a few minutes.
MyAnimeList didn’t accept that code. Tap Sign in again and paste the new code straight away.
